contract: Group a preloaded, complete VVC Annex B byte stream into layer-zero access units using the VVC compatibility policy. The reference uses the public VVC parser and flushes it at the end of the input.
Fold each access unit's original byte offset, length and bytes, in emission order. Both workers require that the access units cover the complete input.
The corpus uses the original FATE assets without remuxing or rewriting bytes. The strict API's missing-zero-byte refusal remains covered by the framing tests.
